terminals.name: api
terminals.description: Trademark Terminal HTTP/MCP API on port 3000 against the local database. It binds every interface here because Cursor forwards a session's ports by watching for listening sockets; the development sign-in endpoint still answers only a caller on this machine.

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Trademark Terminal website (Vite dev server) on port 5173, proxying /api to the API and /docs to VitePress. It binds every interface for the same port-forwarding reason, and signs in automatically as the shared Merchbase Dev Sign-In user, which owns the seeded data. Open this URL to navigate the app.

terminals.name: docs
terminals.description: VitePress product docs on port 5174. The website proxies /docs here, so open http://127.0.0.1:5173/docs.
